meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以调用你本机 Atomic Chat 应用里已下载的模型来处理任务。它会把请求交给本地模型,再把模型生成的回复返回给你。
howto.when: 当你提到“Atomic Chat”、要求用本地模型,或让 Claude 用某个模型回答问题时。

say.text: 用 Atomic Chat 回答:什么是相对论?
say.note: 会先列出可用模型,再选一个生成回答。

say.text: 让本地模型帮我写一段 Python 代码。
say.note: 会选一个本地模型来生成代码。

say.text: 列出 Atomic Chat 目前有哪些模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can call models running in the local Atomic Chat desktop app. It lists available models and sends prompts to a chosen model, then returns the generated response.
howto.when_en: When the user mentions Atomic Chat, asks to use a local model, or requests a model to answer a question.

say_en.text: Use Atomic Chat to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Agent lists models then generates an answer.

say_en.text: Ask the local model to write a Python script for me.
say_en.note: Picks a local model and returns its response.

say_en.text: List the models currently available in Atomic Chat.
